name: learning-loop
title_zh: 每条笔记自带出处、回忆日期和间隔重复倒计时
tagline_zh: 受够了剪藏一堆没读过的文章？它把每条学习笔记钉在原始出处上，自动排复习日程。
tagline_en: Tired of hoarding unread articles? This pins every note to its source, schedules reviews, and keeps a Markdown.
desc_en: Portable source-grounded learning tracks, active recall, spaced repetition, and Markdown evidence ledgers.
why_zh: 不是又一个闪卡工具——它把「来源→笔记→回忆→间隔重复」串成闭环。
why_en: Not another flashcard app—it chains source→note→recall→spaced repetition into one loop, with a ledger showing which knowledge.
limit_zh: 只认 Markdown 文件；需要你自己维护目录结构。不生成闪卡，只排复习计划；不带阅读器，原文得你自己打开。
limit_en: Markdown files only; you maintain the folder structure. No flashcard generation, just review scheduling; no built-in reader. Won't work outside.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Source-grounded notes with recall dates & spaced repetition
